game.title: SIEGECRAFT
game.subtitle: TWO CASTLES · ONE CATAPULT
game.tagline: Wind the arm. Find the angle. Bring the whole castle down.
title.controls.keyboard: Drag to aim & charge · Wheel sets the angle · V to survey
title.controls.gamepad: Left stick aims · Hold RT to charge, release to fire · Y to survey
title.controls.touch: Drag to aim & charge · Stick fine-tunes the angle · Best in landscape
pause.title: Paused
pause.controls.keyboard: Drag: direction & power · W/S or wheel: angle · Hold Space to charge · V survey · R restart
pause.controls.gamepad: Left stick: direction & angle · RT: charge & fire · Right stick / Y: survey · B: cancel
pause.controls.touch: Drag: direction & power · Stick: angle & direction · Hold FIRE to charge
levels.title: Choose a Castle
level.timber.name: Timber Fort
level.timber.desc: A three-storey wooden tower and two lookouts. Wood splinters easily; powder hides on every floor.
level.keep.name: Bluestone Keep
level.keep.desc: Thick walls, twin towers and an inner keep. Stone is heavy and tough — find the powder cellar.
hud.skip.keyboard: Click or press Space to continue
hint.aim.keyboard: Hold and drag down to wind the catapult, drag sideways to turn, release to fire
hint.aim.gamepad: Left stick to turn, hold RT to charge, release to fire
hint.aim.touch: Press and drag down to charge, drag sideways to turn, let go to fire
hint.pitch.keyboard: Mouse wheel or W/S sets the angle: lob over walls, or fire flat into towers
hint.pitch.gamepad: Left stick up/down sets the angle: lob over walls, or fire flat into towers
hint.pitch.touch: Stick up/down sets the angle: lob over walls, or fire flat into towers
hint.survey.keyboard: Press <kbd>V</kbd> or right-drag to circle the castle and find weak spots
hint.survey.gamepad: Push the right stick or press Y to circle the castle and find weak spots
hint.survey.touch: Tap Survey (top right) to circle the castle and find weak spots
hint.powder.keyboard: Red powder barrels blow up on impact and chain collapses! Every unused stone is worth 2,500
hint.powder.gamepad: Red powder barrels blow up on impact and chain collapses! Every unused stone is worth 2,500
hint.powder.touch: Red powder barrels blow up on impact and chain collapses! Every unused stone is worth 2,500
